## Why visit

The key missing stop from the first Rochdale list. Five rotating local casks are backed by an impressive dedicated fridge of real cider and perry; the branch's 2026 Cider Pub of the Year award recognises the programme and its producer variety. This makes an excellent specialist contrast with the historic Baum and Flying Horse, if you choose Rochdale as an excursion. The range is why to go, not a spectacular historic interior.

## Beer

Five changing cask ales with local producers prominent, plus keg from regional breweries.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** Rochdale, Oldham & Bury CAMRA describes eight real ciders/perries in the dedicated fridge, including changing smaller producers; 2026 branch cider winner.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Plan the visit

CAMRA lists Monday and Tuesday closure, then afternoon/evening opening from Wednesday. Check today’s list and any special tasting event before making a cider-specific journey.

**Getting there:** Short walk from Rochdale Metrolink terminus and bus station; also reachable from the railway station.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
